strings.header.skip: Zage zuwa abun da ke ciki
strings.footer.desc: Ilmi Duniya, Gado da Kiyayen Diƙita — TQN Qodiriah Naqsabandiyah. Ɗaya daga cikin tushen, abubuwa da dama.
strings.home.kicker: TQN Qodiriah Naqsabandiyah · Ilmi · Gado · Kiyayen
strings.home.subtitle: Shafin Duniya na Ilmi, Gado da Kiyayen Diƙita na TQN Qodiriah Naqsabandiyah
strings.home.lede: 165 bai wani shafin yanar gizo ba ne. Wata cibiyar diƙita ce — shafin ilmi, takardun, tushe na bincike, jagora, yaren ilimi da tsarin ambato — an gina shi domin kowane magana za ta iya biyan hanya zuwa shaidarta.
strings.home.identityLede: An tsara 165 a matsayin haɗin gwiwar ayyukan cibiyar goma da ke raba tushe ɗaya na bayanai.
strings.home.principleTitle: Ɗaya daga cikin Tushen, Abubuwa da Dama
strings.home.principleLede: Ƙayyadaddun bayani guda ɗaya ya ci gaba da bayani, bincike, taswirar, lokaci, graf, takardun, bincike, ambato, AI, API da ilmin zamani. Ba a nuna sau biyu. Ba a ɗauko.
strings.home.docsTitle: Takardun sarrafawa shida na 165 - Master Control, Gudanarwa, Tsarin Edita, manufofin Tushen - yanzu ana karantunsa cikakke.
strings.home.docsSub: Kwafi verbatim · v1.0 · binciki takardun da yawa · jerin abubuwa
strings.home.depositBody: Takardun sarrafawa shida na kanonik (Master Control 000, Gudanarwa 007, Tsarin Edita 008, Manufofin Tushen da Ambato 009, Master Blueprint, Tsarin Tsari) yanzu an shaida su kuma ana karantunsu cikakke a cikin Gidan Takardun. Takardun Shugaban kasa da sauran takardun da aka bayar har yanzu ana jira - wannan sanarun za ta ci gaba har sai da cikakken bayani ya cika.
strings.sec.explore.title: Kowane bayanan, taswirar ilmi ɗaya
strings.sec.explore.lede: Nemo mutane, cibiyoyi, wurare, al'adu, kaloli, tushen da ikirari. Kowane sakamakon yana da matakin shaida da matsayin tabbatarwa.
strings.sec.library.title: Kara, rubutattun da aka rubuta da tarin
strings.sec.library.lede: Laburaren yana kiran ayyuka da kadarori da bayanan daidai da ambato: rubuta, asali, cibiyoyin da ke riƙe da su da tushen. Babu wani abu da shiga jerin ba tare da bayani ba.
strings.sec.archive.title: Takardun, tarihin baka da bayanan gado
strings.sec.archive.lede: Takardun yana amfani da bayanan diƙita a matsayin gado: an sanya shi siga, an duba shi kuma ana iya fitar da shi. Bayanan tarihi suna da dindin - gyara suna ƙara, ba su cire ba.
strings.sec.research.title: Tushen, ikirari da jerin litattafai
strings.sec.research.lede: Matsayin bincike yana raba abin da aka ce da abin da ke goyon da shi. Ikirarin suna da matsayinsu; tushen suna da matakinsu; babu wani abin da ya fi shaidarsa.
strings.sec.academy.title: Koyon da ke dogaro da tushen, ba iko ba
strings.sec.academy.lede: Makaranta za ta karɓa darussan, tsari da haɗin kai - kowane darasi yana ambaton bayanan da ke goyon da shi. An riga an gina tushe a nan: tsarin kaloli yai da rayuwa.
strings.sec.media.title: Vidio, sauti, fim da hotuna
strings.sec.media.lede: Matsayin miyakarfin zai bayyana taruka, tambayoyi da bidiyo na gado - kowane abu an haɗa shi da abin da ya bayyana, ba ya yaye kyauta.
strings.sec.trust.title: Yadda 165 ke sanin - tsarin amintacce
strings.sec.trust.lede: 165 ba ya nemi a yarda da shi bisa iko. Yana nemo a duba. Kowane bayanan yana da matakin shaida, matsayin tabbatarwa, tushen da cikakken tarihin canjin sa.
strings.sec.about.title: Wata cibiyar, an kafa ta
strings.sec.about.lede: Menene 165, wanda ya kafa shi, yadda ake gudanar da shi, da kuma ilimin da ke kulle kowane bayanan.
strings.sec.documents.title: Gidan Takardun Tsarin 165
strings.sec.documents.lede: Takardun sarrafawa shida da suka kafa tsarukan 165.web.id gaba ɗaya - Master Control, Master Blueprint, Tsarin Tsari, Gudanarwa, Tsarin Edita, da Manufofin Tushen da Ambato - yanzu an bude su domin kowa ya karanta.
strings.sec.seo.kicker: Tsarin Injin Bincike · Taswirar Shafin Jama'a
strings.sec.seo.title: Shafai da injinan bincuke suke so
strings.sec.seo.lede: Shirin gina shafai masu dindin 1,200+ don gado na TQN Qodiriah Naqsabandiyah. Kowane shafi yana da bayanan da aka tsara, alamar ma'ana, URL mai dindin, da kofojin tabbatarwa. An gina shi sau ɗaya - an yi indeksi, an ambato, an gada.
strings.sec.contribute.title: Ƙara bayanan - ta hanyar bincike, ba wucewa
strings.sec.contribute.lede: Jama'a na iya aika da ilmi, tushen, tarihin rayuwa, cibiyoyi, rubutattun da aka rubuta, tarihin baka da gyara. Gudummawa ba wallafa ba ne: kowane an aika da shi an duba shi kafin shiga bayanan.
strings.docs.searchPlaceholder: Nemo cikin takardun shida... misali sanad, kafa, Tier A
strings.docs.noResults: Babu wani sashi na takarda da dace da "{q}". Kalaman kalandin sauran - misalan "sanad", "shaida", "kafa".
strings.docs.verbatimBody: Me karanta a nan shine asalin rubutun kowane takarda - ba fassara ba. Kowane takarda yana da ID na kanoninsa, siga, da matsayin sa na hukuma; canje-canje sun faru ne ta hanyar gudanarwa, ba da edita ba.
strings.docs.closingNote: Wannan takarda ne ke tushen duk shafin yanar gizo: tsarin abin da ke ciki, tsarin shaida A-F, dokokin sanad, har da ilmin edita a sauran shafai duk sun samo asali daga nan. Kuna da gyara ko ƙari ga abin da ke ciki? A ta hanyar hanyar gudummawa - kowane shawarar za a duba, ba a aiwatar da shi ba.
strings.lang.title: Harshe
strings.lang.search: Nemo harshe... (asali, Bahasa Indonesia, Turanci, lambar)
strings.lang.hint: Harshe na 165 shine Bahasa Indonesia. {curated} harshe an zaɓa shi cikakke, {ai} harshe an fassara shi ta AI, kuma sauran harshe za su zaɓa - matsayinsa zai bi Bahasa Indonesia. Abun da ke cikin takardun gado yana a cikin harshen asali.

sanad.title: Sanad TQN a duniya — an rubuta, ba a ƙiraba
sanad.lede: A buƙatin wanda ya kafa, rajistar sanad TQN Qodiriah Naqsabandiyah yanzu cikakke: layukan gargajiya biyu, hanya ta Banten har zuwa majlis TQN 165 Cikangkung, da kuma shugabannin mursyid a duniya — Abah Anom (Suryalaya), Abah Krawanggana, da Abah Sukanta a matsayin tarin musamman. Kowane shafin da ke haɗa ya ɗauke da asali da matsayinsa; sassan da ba a rubuta ba daga littattafan silsilah ana nuna su a matsayin MATA BLOK masu gaskiya.
sanad.displayOnly: Sanad ana nuna ne kawai — tsarin baya ƙirƙira, haɗa, tsammani, ko tabbatar da sanad. Layukan sun shiga ta hanyar Sili → Alaƙa → Shaida → Tsari → Matsayin Tabbatarwa.
sanad.featured: Tarin Musamman — Murshid TQN a Duniya
sanad.featuredLede: An tsara shi musamman bisa buƙatar kai na wanda ya kafa 165.
sanad.blockNote: MATA BLOK — suna jiran rubutawa daga littafin silsilah; 165 baya ƙirƙa sunaye.
sanad.referenceNote: Lamarin da ya dace: sanad Suryalaya (Abah Anom) baya ƙarƙashin 165 — an rubuta shi a matsayin ɗan takarar mursyid TQN a duniya, ba a matsayin maɓallin sanad na majlis 165 ba.
